title: Managed Kubernetes (EKS · GKE · AKS)
prereqs: python3 + pyyaml for the config challenges
No cloud account needed — challenges verify config & decisions
description: Run Kubernetes on the big clouds: the managed control-plane model, provisioning (eksctl/gcloud/az, node pools & groups), cloud IAM & workload identity (IRSA / GKE Workload Identity / AKS), cloud networking (VPC CNI, LoadBalancers, private clusters), autoscaling (Cluster Autoscaler, Karpenter), cloud storage & backups, and cost/ops (spot, right-sizing, upgrades, fleets). Challenges verify the manifests & decisions you author — no cloud account required.
